## HIGH IMPACT

No high-impact breaking changes are present in this diff. No CSS custom properties were renamed or removed, no web component element names were changed, no shadow DOM structure was restructured in a way that would break existing ha-lcars card-mod selectors.

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `hui-map-card` / `hui-map-overview`

**What changed:** `hui-map-card.ts` now conditionally renders `<hui-map-overview id="overview">` only when `this.layout === PANEL_VIEW_LAYOUT && !this.preview` (previously it rendered whenever `this.layout === PANEL_VIEW_LAYOUT`). Additionally, the `.hass` property binding was removed from `<hui-map-overview>` at the `hui-map-card` level. Inside `hui-map-overview.ts`, substantial restructuring occurred: new tabs, zone activity views, spinner states, and a reworked CSS block were added. The component gained new internal layout with `classMap`/`styleMap` directives, new `<ha-spinner>` and `<ha-alert>` child elements, and new CSS classes including what appear to be activity/history tab panels.

**What ha-lcars rule is affected:** The LCARS theme does not currently inject any card-mod CSS targeting `hui-map-overview`, `hui-map-card`, or any `#overview` selector. There are no `card-mod-root-yaml` or `card-mod-card-yaml` rules in the theme source that reference these components. The map card panel view (`hui-panel-view`) is styled in `card-mod-root-yaml` (`.` block) with `margin` and `max-height` rules, but those target `hui-panel-view` directly and are unaffected.

**Potential visual degradation:** If any ha-lcars user has a map card in panel view, the new activity/history overlay panels inside `hui-map-overview` will inherit the LCARS font family and text colors from the global theme variables (`--primary-text-color`, `--font-family`, etc.) but will not receive any LCARS-specific structural treatment. The new `<ha-spinner>` and `<ha-alert>` elements will render with HA default styling inside the map overview shadow DOM. This is tolerable but may look inconsistent.

**Suggested fix:** No immediate fix required for visual correctness. Optionally, add a `card-mod-root-yaml` or card-level rule targeting `hui-map-overview` shadow DOM to apply LCARS font and text color overrides to the new tab/activity panels if map card panel view is used. Example addition to `card-mod-root-yaml`:

```yaml
"hui-map-overview$": |
  :host {
    font-family: var(--font-family);
    --primary-text-color: var(--lcars-background-text);
  }
```

---

### Component: `hui-logbook-card`

**What changed:** `hui-logbook-card.ts` now imports and renders `<ha-alert>` for split-device resolution warnings (the "Resolve split devices" fix, PR #54507). A new `<ha-alert>` element may appear at the top of the logbook card's shadow DOM when split devices are detected.

**What ha-lcars rule is affected:** The LCARS theme does not target `hui-logbook-card` or `ha-alert` in any card-mod rule. The `<ha-alert>` component will inherit theme-level CSS custom properties (`--primary-text-color`, `card-background-color`, etc.) but will not receive any LCARS-specific structural styling.

**Potential visual degradation:** The `<ha-alert>` element inside a logbook card will render with HA's default alert styling (colored left border, background tinted by severity). On the LCARS quaternary gray card background (`--lcars-ui-quaternary` / `--lcars-gray: #666688`), the default alert background may have low contrast or clash with LCARS aesthetics. This is a minor cosmetic issue only visible when split devices are present.

**Suggested fix:** No fix required for most users. Optionally, add a rule in `card-mod-card-yaml` targeting `ha-alert` inside logbook cards, or rely on the existing `warning-color`/`error-color` variables which `ha-alert` respects:

```yaml
# Already defined in defaults.yaml — no change needed:
# warning-color: var(--lcars-sunflower)
# error-color: var(--lcars-dark-red)
```

The existing `warning-color` and `error-color` mappings in `defaults.yaml` will correctly tint the alert. No additional fix needed unless LCARS-specific alert geometry is desired.

### Component: `hui-section-settings-editor` (Section background color picker)

**What changed:** In `hui-section-settings-editor.ts`, the `ui_color` selector for `background_color` now includes `default_color: "default"` as a new property on the selector config. Additionally, the form data initialization changed from `background?.color ?? "default"` to `background?.color` (i.e., `undefined` instead of `"default"` when no color is set). This affects the section background color picker dialog in dashboard edit mode.

**What ha-lcars rule is affected:** The LCARS theme does not directly target `hui-section-settings-editor` or `hui-dialog-edit-section`. The section background color dialog is a modal that falls under `card-mod-dialog-yaml`, which sets `--lcars-primary-text`, `--primary-text-color`, `--card-background-color`, and `--md-sys-color-surface` to the settings card color. The `ui_color` picker component itself is unstyled by LCARS.

**Potential visual degradation:** The change to `undefined` (from `"default"`) for the initial `background_color` value could affect how the color picker renders its initial state (showing no selection vs. showing "default" selected). This is a UX behavior difference, not a visual theme difference. The LCARS dialog color overrides remain valid. No visual breakage.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: Map — New Zone Colors and White Zone Icons

**What changed:** Zones now have their own map color system (`entity-map-colors.ts`, `ha-map-palette.ts`, `zone-marker.ts`) and prefer white icons on zone markers. New CSS custom properties or color tokens may have been introduced internally in the map engine for zone rendering, though these are encapsulated within the map tile/canvas layer and not exposed as themeable CSS variables.

**What ha-lcars rule is affected:** None. LCARS does not style map zone markers.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. If future map zone styling becomes desirable, monitor `zone-marker.ts` for any new CSS custom properties that get exposed.

### Component: Calendar Card — Tentative Event Striped Background

**What changed:** `ha-full-calendar.ts` now applies a striped CSS background to tentative calendar events (PR #54483). This is implemented as a CSS pattern applied to event elements within the calendar's shadow DOM.

**What ha-lcars rule is affected:** The LCARS theme has a `card-mod-card-yaml` rule targeting `ha-full-calendar` inside `.type-calendar` cards:

```yaml
:host(.type-calendar),
ha-card:is(.type-calendar) {
  ha-full-calendar {
    --lcars-primary-text: var(--lcars-background-text) !important;
    ...
  }
}
```

This rule sets text color variables but does not target event backgrounds. The new striped background for tentative events will use HA's default stripe pattern and colors, which may not match the LCARS aesthetic. However, since tentative events are uncommon (Google Calendar / CalDAV with tentative status) this is a low-priority cosmetic gap.

**Suggested fix:** No fix required. Optionally, if LCARS-styled tentative events are desired, add a shadow DOM rule into the calendar card-mod targeting the tentative event class. The specific class name applied by PR #54483 is not visible in the provided diff excerpt, but can be found by inspecting `ha-full-calendar` when a tentative event is present.

### Component: `hui-map-card` — Preview Mode Layout Guard

**What changed:** The map overview panel is now hidden (`!this.preview`) when the map card is rendered in preview mode (e.g., card editor). This prevents the overview from attempting to size itself in the edit dialog.

**What ha-lcars rule is affected:** None. LCARS has no card-mod rules targeting the map card editor preview.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Informational only.
